serverInfo.name: tnt-house-risk-data-api
serverInfo.description: Solana token safety scanner for AI trading agents — 18-point on-chain check in one call: on-chain-provable insider wallet cluster detection (shared first-funder tracing), mint/freeze authority, honeypot risk, LP lock, holder concentration, hidden owner, permanent delegate, buy/sell tax, and more. 3 free checks/day, no signup, no API key — 15 free/day with an email key at tnt-audit.com/risk-api.

authentication.notes: Bearer token is optional. Without one, calls are limited to 3/day per IP (100/day global cap) as an anonymous trial. With a free API key from tnt-audit.com/risk-api, the limit rises to 15/day.

tools.name: check_token_risk
tools.description: Returns a 0-100 safety score, on-chain insider wallet clusters (wallets sharing a first funder), mint/freeze authority status, holder concentration, and live price/liquidity/volume for a single Solana token mint. Use before recommending or executing a trade on any Solana token.

mint.description: The Solana token mint address to check

tools.name: check_token_risk_batch
tools.description: Same as check_token_risk but for up to 25 mints in one call — N mints charged as N calls, same per-call economics as check_token_risk, no bulk discount. All-or-nothing: if the batch can't be fully covered by remaining quota/credit, the whole batch is rejected rather than partially processed.

tools.name: get_token_risk_history
tools.description: Returns hourly historical data points (safety_score, insider_cluster_count, holder_count, price, liquidity, volume) for a mint over the last N days (max 90). Does not count against the free/subscription call quota — pure read from stored history, no live upstream call.

days.description: How many days of history to return (default 30, max 90)
